title: CodeQuest 2024 — BU Annual Hackathon
venue: Innovation Lab, Block A, Bennett University
description: CodeQuest 2024 is Bennett University's flagship 36-hour hackathon where students compete to build innovative solutions to real-world problems. Teams of 2–4 will tackle challenges across domains including EdTech, HealthTech, Sustainability, and Open Innovation. Mentors from leading tech companies will guide teams throughout the event. The top 3 teams win cash prizes and internship opportunities.
eligibility: Open to all Bennett University students. Teams of 2–4.

title: DataThon 2024 — AI & Data Science Challenge
venue: Seminar Hall 2, Bennett University
description: DataThon 2024 is a two-day data science and AI hackathon where participants analyse real datasets to extract meaningful insights and build predictive models. Participants receive access to curated industry datasets and cloud compute credits. Domains include healthcare analytics, urban mobility, and financial forecasting.
eligibility: Open to all students with basic knowledge of Python and data analysis. Individual or team of 2.

title: Ideathon 2024 — Business Innovation Challenge
venue: Auditorium, Bennett University
description: Ideathon is a business ideation competition hosted by E-Cell Bennett. Teams pitch startup ideas across consumer tech, social impact, and deep tech domains. The best pitches are judged by a panel of startup founders, investors, and faculty mentors. Winning teams receive incubation support and seed funding consideration.
eligibility: Open to all Bennett University students. Teams of 2–5.

title: CipherHack — Cybersecurity CTF
venue: Cybersecurity Lab, Block C, Bennett University
description: CipherHack is a 12-hour Capture the Flag (CTF) cybersecurity competition organised by CipherGuard. Participants solve challenges across web exploitation, cryptography, reverse engineering, binary exploitation, and forensics. Suitable for beginners and intermediate practitioners alike — flag categories are difficulty-tiered.
eligibility: Open to all BU students. Individual or teams of 2.

title: SpringHack 2024
venue: Innovation Lab, Block A, Bennett University
description: SpringHack 2024 was Bennett University's inter-semester hackathon focused on social impact technology. Over 80 students across 24 teams participated, building solutions for waste management, rural education, and urban mobility. The winning team developed a peer-to-peer textbook exchange platform.
eligibility: All BU students.

title: DSA Bootcamp — Crack Your Coding Interviews
venue: Seminar Hall 1, Bennett University
description: A 2-day intensive Data Structures and Algorithms bootcamp designed to prepare students for placements and competitive programming. Sessions cover arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, dynamic programming, and sorting algorithms — with hands-on problem-solving throughout. Bring your laptop with any IDE configured.
eligibility: Open to all BU students. Basic programming knowledge required.

title: Introduction to Machine Learning with Python
venue: CS Lab 3, Block B, Bennett University
description: A beginner-friendly workshop introducing machine learning concepts using Python and scikit-learn. Topics include supervised learning, regression, classification, model evaluation, and a hands-on project building a spam email classifier. No prior ML experience required.
eligibility: Open to all BU students. Python basics helpful but not mandatory.

title: React.js Bootcamp — Build Modern Web Apps
venue: CS Lab 1, Block B, Bennett University
description: A one-day hands-on bootcamp on React.js for students who want to build modern, component-based web applications. Topics include JSX, hooks (useState, useEffect), routing with React Router, state management with Context API, and deployment on Vercel. Participants will build a fully functional To-Do + Notes app.
eligibility: Open to all students. Basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript knowledge required.

title: Arduino Fundamentals — Build Your First Robot
venue: Electronics Lab, Block D, Bennett University
description: A beginner-friendly robotics workshop where participants learn Arduino programming, circuit design, and sensor integration. Each participant (or pair) will build and program a line-following robot from scratch. All components provided. No prior electronics experience needed.
eligibility: Open to all BU students. No prerequisites.

title: Getting Started with AWS Cloud
venue: CS Lab 2, Block B, Bennett University
description: An introductory workshop on Amazon Web Services (AWS) covering core services — EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda. Participants will deploy a simple web application to AWS free-tier resources. Great preparation for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam.
eligibility: Open to all students. Bring a laptop. AWS free-tier account needed (creation guidance provided).

title: Ethical Hacking Workshop — Intro to Penetration Testing
venue: CS Lab 3, Block B, Bennett University
description: An introduction to ethical hacking concepts including network scanning, vulnerability assessment, and basic exploit techniques using Kali Linux. Students learned responsible disclosure principles and practical tools such as Nmap, Burp Suite, and SQLMap in a controlled lab environment.
eligibility: All BU students.

title: Research Paper Writing & Publication Workshop
venue: Seminar Hall 3, Bennett University
description: A workshop for students interested in writing and publishing academic research papers. Sessions covered literature review, research methodology, writing structure, abstract formulation, and IEEE citation format. Participants received feedback on their draft abstracts from faculty mentors.
eligibility: Open to BU students. Preference for final-year and postgraduate students.

title: CipherGuard Monthly CTF Challenge — November
venue: Online (Virtual Event)
description: CipherGuard's monthly Capture the Flag cybersecurity challenge. This month's CTF features beginner and intermediate difficulty tracks with challenges in web security, cryptography, and binary exploitation. Top scorers will feature on the hall of fame.
eligibility: Open to all BU students and alumni.

title: IEEE TechTalk — AI in Healthcare
venue: Seminar Hall 2, Bennett University
description: An IEEE seminar featuring a panel of healthcare AI researchers and industry practitioners discussing real-world applications of machine learning in diagnostics, drug discovery, and patient care management. Q&A session follows the panel discussion.
eligibility: Open to all BU students and faculty.

title: RoboFest 2024 — Inter-College Robotics Competition
venue: Sports Ground & Innovation Lab, Bennett University
description: RoboFest 2024 was Bennett University's inter-college robotics competition featuring events including line-following robots, autonomous drones, sumo bots, and robotic arm challenges. Over 15 colleges from Delhi-NCR participated, with BU Robotics Club winning gold in the drone obstacle course.
eligibility: Competing teams from registered colleges.

title: Udaan 2024 — Annual Cultural Fest
venue: Main Campus Grounds & Auditorium, Bennett University
description: Udaan 2024 is Bennett University's flagship annual cultural festival spanning 3 days. Featuring over 30 events including Bollywood dance competitions, classical music performances, stand-up comedy nights, art exhibitions, fashion shows, and a headline DJ night. Open to students from all universities across Delhi-NCR.
eligibility: Open to all. BU students get priority registration. Spot registrations available.

title: Open Mic Night — November Edition
venue: Campus Amphitheatre, Bennett University
description: Monthly open mic night welcoming student performers — stand-up comedy, poetry slam, acoustic music, beatboxing, spoken word, and more. Sign up to perform or simply enjoy the show. Audience entry is free. Performing slots are 5–10 minutes each.
eligibility: Open to all BU students and staff. Audience: open to all.

title: Media Fest 2024 — Journalism & Photography Competition
venue: Media Lab & Seminar Hall 1, Bennett University
description: Media Fest 2024 showcased student talent in journalism, photography, videography, and content creation. Events included live news reporting simulations, photo-walk competitions, short film screenings, and a panel discussion on digital media ethics. Judged by Times of India senior journalists.
eligibility: Open to all BU students. Journalism and media students prioritised for some events.

title: BUMUN 2024 — Bennett Model United Nations
venue: Seminar Hall 1 & 2, Bennett University
description: BUMUN 2024 was Bennett University's annual Model United Nations conference featuring five committees including UNSC, WHO, UNGA, and DISEC. Over 200 delegates from 18 Delhi-NCR colleges participated. The conference addressed pressing global issues including climate financing, global health security, and cybersovereignty.
eligibility: Open to all college students. Advanced registration required.

title: Inter-Dept Cricket League 2024
venue: Cricket Ground, Bennett University Campus
description: The Inter-Department Cricket League 2024 is a T20 cricket tournament featuring 8 teams representing different academic departments. Matches are held on weekend mornings across 3 weekends. The event culminates in a finals day with trophy presentation and awards for best batsman, bowler, and fielder of the tournament.
eligibility: Open to all registered BU students. Departmental team registration required.
